sources.title: CDC Physical Activity Guidelines for School-Aged Children and Adolescents
AAP Resistance Training for Children and Adolescents

exercises.name: Easy march and jog
instructions: March forward for 30 seconds, then jog easily for 30 seconds.
Repeat while staying relaxed and able to speak in short sentences.
exercises.easierOption: March for the whole interval.
exercises.harderOption: Add gentle direction changes without increasing to an all-out pace.

exercises.name: Dynamic mobility flow
instructions: Perform ankle rocks, hip openers, arm circles, and controlled leg swings.
Move continuously and stay within a comfortable range.
exercises.easierOption: Use a smaller range of motion.
exercises.harderOption: Add a slow walking lunge with an easy reach.

exercises.name: Ball foundation touches
instructions: Alternate inside touches, outside touches, and sole rolls.
Keep the ball close and work with both feet.
exercises.easierOption: Walk and pause between touch patterns.
exercises.harderOption: Use a smaller space while keeping control.

exercises.name: Wall pass and first touch
instructions: Pass against a safe wall or to a partner.
Use the first touch to move the ball slightly to the side, then pass again.
exercises.easierOption: Stop the ball before each pass.
exercises.harderOption: Use two touches while maintaining accuracy.

exercises.name: Marker dribble and turn
instructions: Dribble to a marker, perform a controlled turn, and return.
Change the turning foot each repetition.
exercises.easierOption: Walk through the turn.
exercises.harderOption: Use a different turn each repetition.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat to target
instructions: Stand in front of a stable bench or chair with feet around shoulder width.
Sit back under control, touch the target lightly, then stand tall.
coachingCues: Stop the set before technique changes
exercises.easierOption: Use a higher target and fewer repetitions.
exercises.harderOption: Lower the target slightly while keeping the same control.

exercises.name: Supported reverse lunge
instructions: Hold a stable support and step one foot backward.
Lower only as far as comfortable, then push through the front foot to return.
exercises.easierOption: Use a shorter step and smaller range.
exercises.harderOption: Use less hand support without adding weight.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift the hips until the body forms a comfortable straight line, pause, and lower.
exercises.easierOption: Use a smaller lift.
exercises.harderOption: Pause for two seconds at the top.

exercises.name: Supported calf raise
instructions: Hold a stable support and rise onto the balls of both feet.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
exercises.easierOption: Use fewer repetitions.
exercises.harderOption: Pause for two seconds at the top.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
instructions: Place hands on a stable raised surface and step back into a straight-body position.
Lower the chest toward the surface, then press away.
coachingCues: Keep the body in one line
Choose a height that allows control
exercises.easierOption: Use a higher surface.
exercises.harderOption: Use a slightly lower surface.

exercises.name: Resistance-band row
instructions: Use a light band attached to a secure anchor checked by an adult.
Pull the handles toward the ribs, pause, and return slowly.
coachingCues: Use a light band that preserves technique
exercises.easierOption: Use a lighter band or stand closer to the anchor.
exercises.harderOption: Add two repetitions before increasing resistance.

exercises.name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on the back with arms up and knees bent.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg, return, and change sides.
coachingCues: Use a smaller range if needed
exercises.easierOption: Move only one arm or one leg at a time.
exercises.harderOption: Pause briefly before returning.

exercises.name: Side plank from knees
instructions: Lie on one side with knees bent and elbow beneath the shoulder.
Lift the hips, hold with normal breathing, then change sides.
coachingCues: Body forms a straight line from head to knees
exercises.easierOption: Hold for 10 seconds.
exercises.harderOption: Build the hold toward 25 seconds.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance reach
instructions: Stand beside a support on one foot with the knee softly bent.
Reach the free foot forward, sideways, and backward, then change legs.
exercises.easierOption: Keep one hand on the support.
exercises.harderOption: Use fingertip support only.

exercises.name: March and skip mechanics
instructions: March for 10 metres with an opposite arm and knee action.
Return and repeat as a gentle skip without racing.
exercises.easierOption: Use marching only.
exercises.harderOption: Increase rhythm slightly while staying coordinated.

exercises.name: Controlled 10-metre acceleration
instructions: Start from a balanced athletic stance.
Accelerate smoothly for 10 metres at a fast but controlled effort, then walk back.
exercises.easierOption: Use a 6-metre acceleration at a moderate effort.
exercises.harderOption: Add one repetition only after consistent technique.

exercises.name: Deceleration and balance
instructions: Jog toward a marker, slow down over several short steps, and finish balanced.
Hold the finish for two seconds before walking back.
exercises.easierOption: Approach at a slower jog.
exercises.harderOption: Approach slightly faster without shortening the braking area.

exercises.name: Lateral shuffle and balance
instructions: Shuffle sideways between two markers without crossing the feet.
Stop balanced at each marker and change direction.
exercises.easierOption: Reduce the distance and move slowly.
exercises.harderOption: Increase the pace slightly while keeping clean stops.

exercises.name: Ball tempo interval
instructions: Dribble continuously around a simple marker course at a comfortable steady pace.
During recovery, walk with the ball and regain relaxed breathing.
coachingCues: Finish each interval able to continue with good technique
exercises.easierOption: Use 30 seconds of work and 60 seconds of walking.
exercises.harderOption: Add one interval before increasing pace.

exercises.name: Easy walk and reset
instructions: Walk slowly until breathing feels settled.
Finish with comfortable calf, thigh, and hip movements without forcing range.
exercises.easierOption: Continue easy walking only.
exercises.harderOption: No harder option is needed for a cooldown.
